summary: The user request was implemented as Korean-first, click-centered native desktop workspace UX with Tauri native folder selection and a dedicated file/code workbench.

acceptance.criterion: Native folder picker and filesystem workspace visibility
File/code section is no longer a static snapshot viewer

residual_risks: Actual OS dialog interaction should still be smoke-tested in a packaged/internal Tauri app because browser static smoke cannot open native OS dialogs.
Public distribution remains blocked by existing signing/notarization/updater/clean-machine gates.
